experiment: Numeric and percent spelling after protected article deletion
baseline: Saved guarded article-deletion summaries, QA913/970; no fresh generation
treatments: percent_only swaps percent notation after quantities; numbers_percent additionally swaps supported digits and English cardinal forms. Only residual source matches >=6 words may be edited. Absolute copied words and coverage fraction must decrease.
preservation: Exact Decimal value and decimal-place/sign roundtrip; supported English grammar; protected formula/operator/LaTex/code spans and identifier/reference exclusions. Digit/word changes deliberately require an extended numeric-preservation audit rather than the old digit-only signature.
scope: Controlled supported cardinals up to999999999999 and at most6 decimal places/12 output words. Ambiguous word numbers require noun/quantity context. No ordinals or scientific notation conversion.
evaluation: Same original970 MCQs, prompts, parser, sampling and paired seeds. All final narratives audited against full original sources with separate expanded diagnostic. All changed visible sentences reviewed; no QA-driven output selection.
interpretation: Notation changes reduce literal matches but are not independent semantic paraphrases. Report absolute coverage and narrative length to expose denominator effects.
percent_grammar: Numeric spelling changes replace a complete percentage quantity, e.g.25% to twenty-five percent and five percent to5%; never five% or twenty-five%. Unit-only swaps apply to digit quantities.
